response.original_title: The 16th Goddess of Stardom Tag Team League Tournament in OKAZAKI
response.overview: The full schedule for the 16th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League Tournament, which kicks off on Sunday, November 1st at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, has been decided. This tournament will be divided into two blocks, Red Goddesses and Blue Goddesses, with 9 teams in each block, for a total of 18 teams. A total of 72 official matches will be held until Saturday, November 28th at the Okazaki City Gymnasium in Aichi. The top two teams from each block will advance to the final tournament.
response.title: The 16th Goddess of Stardom Tag Team League Tournament in OKAZAKI
